title: Enterprise Connectivity: filed acceptance evidence
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this filed acceptance evidence rule to authorized-source pricing.

## Basis: authorized
For authorized-source pricing, read the sole pending customer authorization with source classification request that names this exact selected export bundle and related selected assessment; its net service subtotal is the authorized ceiling, and absence contributes zero. Two distinct pending acceptances for that same source and review are outside this single-acceptance route. An unsigned nonfinancial service record is not a customer request and contributes zero even though its stable form identifier is already visible in the recorded evidence; only the customer filing action converts it into the pending request whose net ceiling can enter this sum.
